cases.name: OAuth2 initial grant
cases.given: no body — client credentials go in the Authorization header
then: access_token, refresh_token and access_token_expire_in all present
cases.note: This is the live mechanism. /rest/v1/tokens/generate is legacy v1 and its token is never used for a v2 call, so it is deliberately absent from the mock.

checks.label: status

checks.label: access_token
checks.what: the token every business call carries

checks.label: refresh_token
checks.what: needed for the refresh grant

checks.label: access_token_expire_in
checks.what: AuthenticateResponseDTO maps it through a private setter; absent means no expiry known

cases.name: OAuth2 refresh grant
cases.given: grant_type refresh_token, posted to the same URL
cases.note: Wms3RequestHandler posts initial and refresh to one URL, so the store is the only way to prove which one happened.

checks.label: status
checks.what: refresh posts to the SAME url as the initial grant

checks.label: both grants recorded and distinguishable
checks.what: token_grants keeps grant_type as sent; the initial grant has no body
